engine_requirements: Add adapter 'rss_filtered' (or an optional adapter_config.match on the rss adapter). Request: plain GET https://www.nsf.gov/rss/rss_www_funding.xml with UA. Parse RSS 2.0 channel/item: title, link, guid (use guid, fallback link), pubDate, description (strip tags, unescape entities, collapse whitespace). Keep an item only if regex adapter_config.match (case-insensitive, applied to title + ' ' + description) matches. Map external_id = guid, title = title, url = link, published = pubDate, deadline = first 'deadline|due|closing date' phrase with a date in the description, else null, status = 'open'. Since the feed is a rolling window of about 20 items, the edge function must upsert by external_id and must not mark items missing from a later fetch as closed. Respect 2s host spacing. Never ingest unfiltered items for a single-program row.
prototype:
import re, sys, urllib.request, html
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
FEED = "https://www.nsf.gov/rss/rss_www_funding.xml"
# IUCRC filter (production pattern). Argument overrides it for the demo run.
PATTERN = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else r"Industry[- /]?University Cooperative Research|\bIUCRC\b"
req = urllib.request.Request(FEED, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36 SALSAV-GrantWatch/1.0"})
raw = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30).read()
root = ET.fromstring(raw)
items = root.findall("./channel/item")
rx = re.compile(PATTERN, re.I)
out = []
for it in items:
    title = (it.findtext("title") or "").strip()
    link = (it.findtext("link") or "").strip()
    guid = (it.findtext("guid") or link).strip()
    desc = html.unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", it.findtext("description") or ""))
    desc = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", desc).strip()
    if not rx.search(title + " " + desc):
        continue
    m = re.search(r"(?:deadline|due|closing date|submission deadline)[^.]{0,80}?(\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{4}|[A-Z][a-z]+ \d{1,2}, \d{4})", desc, re.I)
    out.append({"external_id": guid, "title": title, "url": link,
                "published": it.findtext("pubDate"), "deadline": m.group(1) if m else None,
                "status": "open"})
print("feed_items", len(items), "matched", len(out))
for o in out[:5]:
    print(o)
